landing.kicker: A calmer way to start a consultation
landing.title: Tell us how you've been feeling, in your own language
landing.subtitle: Bedside listens, asks a few simple lifestyle questions, and prepares a clear summary so your doctor can focus on you from the very first minute.
landing.step1Body: Describe what's bothering you, by voice or text, in your own language.
landing.step2Body: A few short questions about sleep, diet, stress and other everyday habits.
landing.step3Body: Answer at your own pace - one topic at a time, nothing to prepare in advance.
landing.step4Body: Your answers become a lifestyle wellness score and plain-language recommendations.
landing.step5Body: Your doctor reviews a clear summary before or during your visit.
landing.disclaimer: Bedside is a screening and documentation aid. It does not diagnose conditions or prescribe medication, and it always defers to your doctor. In a medical emergency, contact your doctor or local emergency services immediately.

auth.registerSubtitle: For patients only. Your doctor's account is created separately.
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to continue your care.

consent.title: Before we begin
consent.subtitle: Please read this before starting a consultation.
consent.collectedBody: We record what you type or say, along with basic lifestyle details like sleep, diet, exercise and stress levels, to prepare a summary for your doctor.
consent.doctorBody: Your doctor will see everything you share here, along with the wellness summary, before or during your visit.
consent.notDiagnosisBody: Bedside does not diagnose conditions, prescribe medication, or replace medical advice. Only your doctor can do that.
consent.emergencyBody: If you are having a medical emergency, please contact your doctor or local emergency services right away - do not wait for this tool.
consent.checkboxLabel: I have read and understood this, and I consent to sharing this information with my doctor.
